question: Select the most appropriate antonym of the word: **Erudite**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Ignorant**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"Erudite"** means having or showing great knowledge or learning. (विद्वान)
 
 
• **Example:** The professor was an erudite scholar who had published numerous books on ancient history.
 
 
• The word **"Ignorant"** refers to a lack of knowledge, education, or awareness about something. (अज्ञानी)
 
 
• **Example:** He was ignorant of the fact that the rules had changed last week.
